note: Phase -> owning role for each workflow. Phase ids are stable labels, not necessarily a 1:1 mapping to every heading in the workflow document. Read the workflow first, then this roster.

01-scaffold-fullstack-app.goal: Greenfield Django + DRF + Next.js + Docker project that boots and passes the gate.

phases.exit_evidence: docker compose config exits 0; only the proxy publishes ports; entrypoints end with exec "$@".
config/ namespace in place; apps registered un-prefixed; /api/health/ returns success.
SSR fetch uses the internal host; CSR uses the public base URL; apiClient is absent from server files.
Stack boots from a documented command on a clean machine; health probe green; verification report attached.

02-setup-secure-auth.goal: Dual HttpOnly cookie auth with OTP, enforced by middleware and permission classes.

phases.exit_evidence: Cookie flags verified; refresh rotates; logout revokes; permission_classes present on every view.
Middleware distinguishes missing vs expired access; no token in JS; single-flight refresh demonstrated.
Login -> refresh -> logout exercised end to end with captured requests; OTP lockout demonstrated.

03-enable-cart-feature.goal: Redis-backed cart with guest identity, atomic mutations, and merge-on-login.

phases.exit_evidence: Every mutation is atomic (primitive named); key TTLs and ownership documented; merge is idempotent.
Cart endpoints match client calls; guest header contract documented; cache-prevention headers present.
Guest UUID survives reload; monotonic guard in place; merge-on-login visible in the UI.
Double-submit cannot corrupt the cart; guest cart merges once; stock failure paths exercised.
